review_description: We were dissapointed with Nicholls Solar. I negotiated the cost but was waiting for feedback on the extra charge to reconfigure the meter box. I requested the confirmation on October 17th and got caught when the announcement came through on October 27th. I immediately went with my next best quote (which was 12% more expensive) and sent the deposit. Their service let them down and lost them the sale. We also had real trouble getting a lead time indication.
